entries.description: Started Session 1 of platform-post-cutover-hardening, verified API keys, identified the active session set, confirmed rebuild-consolidation is complete, read the session spec, and checked the existing app/API health endpoints and baseline tests before beginning the diagnostics cleanup work.

Created docs/health-endpoint-contract.md to define the supported /health payload contract for both hosts, including the shared service/status/environment/version fields and the Web host's deliveryMode extension.

Replaced the session-6 cutover stage breadcrumb in both /health endpoints with durable environment/version diagnostics and added a shared HealthResponseFactory in AcmeCoffeeOnline.Shared so the Web and API hosts emit the same stable contract.
Updated the Web and API health endpoint tests to parse the JSON payload and assert the expected environment, assembly version, and Web deliveryMode so contract drift fails fast.
Ran dotnet build Dabbler.Platform.sln and dotnet test Dabbler.Platform.sln successfully; the full solution test run passed, including Playwright coverage.

Sent the Session 1 spec excerpt, changed health contract files, and successful build/test results to the external verifier. The round-1 verifier response concluded the session passed, but it used a PASS heading instead of the workflow's machine-parseable VERIFIED prefix, so the raw output was saved and a clarification round was requested.

Ran a clarification verification round because the first verifier response used a PASS heading instead of the workflow's machine-parseable verdict prefix. Round 2 returned VERIFIED using gemini-pro, and the raw follow-up was appended to the saved session review.

Started Session 2 of platform-post-cutover-hardening, verified API keys, identified the active session set, confirmed rebuild-consolidation is complete, checked Session 1 prerequisites and existing workflow/auth helper paths, and reviewed the relevant guardrail and auth-mode docs before adding observability changes.

Added structured Development/Test auth observability for dev magic-link capture, seeded-session issuance, and magic-link diagnostics access by introducing stable event IDs and structured fields in Dabbler.Security.DevEmailSender and the Web app auth helper endpoints.

Added ai-router session-verification start/completion logging through the ai_router.session_verification logger, created docs/workflow-auth-observability.md for local and CI-like inspection guidance, and refined the doc after the routed documentation draft was auto-verified with completeness issues.

Added smoke coverage that captures structured logs from DevEmailSender and the Web auth helper endpoints, plus workflow-asset checks that fail if the session-verification log markers or observability runbook disappear.
Ran dotnet build Dabbler.Platform.sln and dotnet test Dabbler.Platform.sln successfully; the full solution test run passed, including 5 Playwright tests and the new Web observability smoke checks.

Sent the Session 2 spec excerpt, changed auth/workflow observability files, and successful build/test results to the external verifier. The round-1 verifier concluded the session was complete and correct, but it used a COMPLETE AND CORRECT heading instead of the workflow's machine-parseable VERIFIED prefix, so the raw output was saved and a clarification round was requested.

Ran a clarification verification round because the first verifier response did not use the workflow's required verdict prefix. The follow-up verification escalated to opus and returned VERIFIED, and the raw clarification output was appended to the saved session review.

Started Session 3 of platform-post-cutover-hardening, verified API keys, identified the active session set, confirmed prior-session prerequisites exist, reviewed the session spec and guardrails, and gathered the Playwright and startup-smoke infrastructure before running the routed flake analysis.

Routed the Session 3 flake review through ai-router using the current Playwright fixture, smoke tests, workflow asset smoke test, observability smoke checks, and launch profiles. The external analysis identified the highest-risk flake points as startup/process lifecycle assumptions, helper-page polling for magic-link capture, and the Windows-only workflow asset smoke test.

Hardened the Playwright fixture and smoke coverage by probing /health before self-starting, validating build outputs, surfacing recent process output on startup failures, resolving the repo root dynamically, using concurrent browser-issue tracking, switching magic-link helper polling to direct HTTP, tightening helper-page navigation timeouts, making the workflow asset smoke test pure C#, and restoring toggled product availability so repeated runs remain deterministic.

Created docs/flake-resistance-guidance.md to capture the durable startup, helper-polling, and smoke-test determinism rules for future session sets, using an ai-router documentation draft that was cross-provider verified before the checked-in version was finalized.

Ran dotnet build Dabbler.Platform.sln and dotnet test Dabbler.Platform.sln successfully. The full solution build passed cleanly, and the solution test run passed with 342 tests including the hardened 5-test Playwright suite and 9 Web smoke/integration tests.

Sent the Session 3 spec, touched-file diff, and successful build/test evidence to the external verifier. The round-1 verifier returned VERIFIED with no issues, confirming the flake-resistance hardening and guidance changes satisfied the session requirements.

Generated docs/session-sets/platform-post-cutover-hardening/change-log.md for the completed session set using an ai-router documentation draft that was cross-provider verified before the checked-in summary was finalized.
